gpu.note: the GPU the embeddings were computed on is in embeddings.<backbone>.<id_set>.<split>.device_name; nvidia-smi here describes the machine that wrote this manifest, which may be a login node

resnet18_cifar_openood.description: OpenOOD ResNet18_32x32 on CIFAR-10, post-avgpool 512-d. Prefers cifar10_res18_v1.5; accepts cifar10_res18 (v1) when v1.5 is unavailable — see provenance.openood_checkpoint_version and benchmark_pairing_note. On CIFAR-100 ID this is the reverse-overlap case (trained on what is now near-OOD).

frozen_from.preprocessor: base (Resize(32, bilinear), CenterCrop(32), ToTensor, Normalize cifar10)

checkpoint.benchmark_pairing_note: checkpoint is OpenOOD v1 (cifar10_res18); PhaseC far-OOD ladder follows the v1.5 taxonomy (MNIST, SVHN, Textures, Places365) rather than v1's FashionMNIST. Numbers are not drop-in comparable to the published OpenOOD v1 leaderboard row.

resnet50_imagenet.description: torchvision resnet50 IMAGENET1K_V1, fc stripped, post-avgpool 2048-d

vitb16_imagenet.description: timm vit_base_patch16_224 (augreg2_in21k_ft_in1k), CLS after final norm, 768-d

dinov2_vitb14.description: DINOv2 ViT-B/14 (LVD-142M), CLS token after final norm, 768-d

frozen_from.transforms: Resize(256, bicubic), CenterCrop(224), Normalize ImageNet (dinov2/data/transforms.py make_classification_eval_transform)

clip_vitb16.description: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/16 image tower (timm quickgelu variant), projected 512-d

frozen_from.timm_crop_pct_override: OpenAI's preprocess has no crop_pct (resize == crop == 224); timm's pretrained_cfg lists 0.9, which is timm's own convention

datasets.difficulty_axis: OpenOOD near/far labels are informational only. Reported difficulty ordering and reach-vs-difficulty plots use measured identity-baseline AUROC per (backbone, ood_set, scorer) from generalisation_audit.csv.
datasets.tin_filter_note: CIFAR-10 TIN must come from an OpenOOD/SCOOD filtered imglist (~1,207 CIFAR-10-class overlaps removed). Raw images_classic/tin is refused.
datasets.note: per-split source, counts, imglist_sha256 and seeds are under `embeddings`

openood_resnet18_pairing.benchmark_pairing_note: checkpoint is OpenOOD v1 (cifar10_res18); PhaseC far-OOD ladder follows the v1.5 taxonomy (MNIST, SVHN, Textures, Places365) rather than v1's FashionMNIST. Numbers are not drop-in comparable to the published OpenOOD v1 leaderboard row.
